Could this install be grant-funded?

Most commercial and fleet installs are. Run the numbers in the grant + cost calculator, then read the Workplace Charging Scheme and EV Infrastructure Grant guides before you commission work.

Frequently asked questions

Is TLS Electrical and Air-Conditioning OZEV-authorised for commercial work?
Yes. TLS Electrical and Air-Conditioning appears on the official GOV.UK OZEV authorised installer list for commercial/fleet installations as of 2026-05-18. Always confirm current status directly before contracting.
Can I get a grant towards this installation?
Commercial and fleet installs are frequently part-funded by the Workplace Charging Scheme (up to £500/socket from 1 April 2026) and the EV Infrastructure Grant. The installer applies these for you.
How do I get a quote from TLS Electrical and Air-Conditioning?
Use the “Request a quote” button on this page, or add them to your shortlist and request quotes from several installers at once.
